data.narrative:
Climeworks is a Series F-stage direct air capture company founded by Christoph Gebald and Jan Wurzbacher, operating in the Climate & Energy sector. The company has raised over $1.0B to date. The comparable universe consists of one public peer (Linde, ticker LNZA) and eight private Climate & Energy companies, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, as peer-median triangulation is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set. The stage-progression method applies a typical Series F forward step-up multiplier of 1.3x to the $1.0B total capital raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $1.3B. This represents the only quantitative method with sufficient data coverage for this analysis.

The triangulated valuation range spans $1.1B (low) to $1.5B (high), with a median point estimate of $1.3B. This analysis is constrained by a limited peer dataset at this stage and valuation tier in Climate & Energy; the wide range reflects meaningful uncertainty around appropriate forward multiples for pre-exit frontier-tech companies. Additional data on comparable Series F or later-stage capital rounds, or exit multiples from the broader sector, would narrow this range materially.
